name: Whey protein

typical_dose_shape.note: No FDA-approved dosing reference exists for this compound. This range describes reported use and is not a recommendation.

description: The soluble protein fraction of milk, a complete protein rich in leucine. Used to meet protein intake targets supporting muscle protein synthesis; it is a food ingredient rather than a pharmacological agent.

systems.note: Supplies dietary protein and leucine supporting muscle protein synthesis; the intended effect.
Raises blood urea nitrogen and, at high intakes, creatinine, through protein load rather than reduced filtration.

monitors.why: The effect the supplement is taken for.
Rises with protein load without a fall in filtration.
Filtration marker unaffected by protein or muscle mass.
